blocks.text: Why Attached Housing Is Leading the Way

parts.t: This shift isn't a mystery. It's being driven by something every Langley buyer already feels —
detached ownership has moved out of reach for a lot of young families
. As prices climbed through the last cycle, townhouses and condos became the realistic on-ramp to homeownership, especially for households with kids.
But it isn't just about affordability. Newer

product comes with three-bedroom layouts, double garages, fenced yards, and walkable proximity to schools — which used to be the calling card of detached. For a lot of families, attached housing isn't a compromise anymore. It's the right fit.
